cnTitle: 大限走太阴这十年：向内积累、细腻经营，怎么把柔劲用成底气
enTitle: The Tai Yin Decade: Turning Inward Accumulation and Refined Care Into Real Strength
enDesc: Tai Yin governs inwardness, refinement, nurturing and taste. In its decade the rhythm leans inward, toward settling, detail and long-term building, suiting deep expertise, home and asset care and steady accumulation. The strength is fine perception and the ability to nurture and hold; the risk is emotional drain, hesitation and passivity, so the key is directing refinement into concrete tasks and setting one’s own rhythm.
cnDesc: 太阴主内敛、细腻、滋养与审美，大限走太阴的十年，人生节奏偏「向内、沉淀、经营细节」，适合深耕专业、打理家宅与资产、做长期积累。好处是感知细、能守能养，风险是情绪内耗、犹豫被动，关键是把细腻落到具体事上、给自己定节奏。

cnTitle: 大限走天同这十年：缓和、享受与人情，怎么把舒服过成不松散
enTitle: The Tian Tong Decade: Ease, Enjoyment and Connection Without Slacking Off
enDesc: Tian Tong governs warmth, enjoyment, connection and service. In its decade the rhythm leans gentle, feeling-oriented and relational, suiting service, creativity, education and roles built on approachability. The strength is good rapport, low pressure and enjoying the process; the risk is slack, procrastination and weak drive, so the key is setting goals and discipline within the ease.
cnDesc: 天同主温和、享受、人情与服务，大限走天同的十年，人生节奏偏「缓和、重感受、讲人情」，适合服务、创意、文教与靠亲和力立身的事。好处是人缘好、压力小、能享受过程，风险是松散拖延、缺冲劲，关键是在舒服里给自己立目标和纪律。

cnTitle: 大限走廉贞这十年：规则、交际与分寸，怎么把历练用成事业
enTitle: The Lian Zhen Decade: Rules, Sociability and Tact, Turning Experience Into Career
enDesc: Lian Zhen governs rules, sociability, tact and experience, and is also a secondary romance star. In its decade the theme leans to refining oneself within relationships and rules, suiting management, law and enforcement, public relations, culture and fields requiring tact. The strength is broad connections, knowing the rules and gaining experience; the risk is legal disputes, words and romantic tangles, so the key is holding contracts and boundaries and directing tact into real work.
cnDesc: 廉贞主规则、交际、分寸与历练，也次桃花，大限走廉贞的十年，人生主题偏「在关系和规则里打磨自己」，适合管理、政法、公关、文化与需要分寸感的行业。好处是交际广、懂规矩、能历练，风险是官非口舌、感情纠葛，关键是守住合约与边界、把分寸用在正事上。

cnTitle: 大限走天相这十年：协调、辅佐与稳定，怎么把配合做成自己的位置
enTitle: The Tian Xiang Decade: Coordination, Support and Stability, Making Partnership Into Your Own Place
enDesc: Tian Xiang governs integrity, coordination, support and systems. In its decade the theme leans to partnership, coordination and standing firm within a structure, suiting administration, human resources, legal affairs, operations and supporting roles. The strength is steadiness, tact and coordination; the risk is passively following others and lacking one’s own view, so the key is building personal judgment and irreplaceability alongside support.
cnDesc: 天相主正派、协调、辅佐与制度，大限走天相的十年，人生主题偏「配合、协调、在体系里站稳」，适合行政、人事、法务、运营与辅佐型岗位。好处是稳、懂分寸、能协调，风险是被动随人、缺主张，关键是在辅佐之外练出自己的判断和不可替代性。

cnTitle: 大限走天梁这十年：原则、荫庇与专业，怎么把成熟用成权威
enTitle: The Tian Liang Decade: Principles, Shelter and Expertise, Turning Maturity Into Authority
enDesc: Tian Liang governs principles, shelter, maturity and oversight. In its decade the theme leans to setting principles, building expertise and caring for and guiding others, suiting education, medicine, law, consulting and senior management built on experience and credentials. The strength is steadiness, the ability to catch people and easy trust; the risk is proud isolation and lecturing, so the key is directing principles into expertise and shelter into service.
cnDesc: 天梁主原则、荫庇、成熟与督导，大限走天梁的十年，人生主题偏「立原则、做专业、照顾与督导他人」，适合教育、医疗、法律、咨询、资深管理等靠经验和资格立身的领域。好处是稳重、能兜底、易得信任，风险是孤高说教、好为人师，关键是把原则用在专业上、把荫庇化成服务。

cnTitle: 大限走巨门这十年：表达、辨析与口舌，怎么把话说成资本
enTitle: The Ju Men Decade: Expression, Analysis and Words, Turning Speech Into Capital
enDesc: Ju Men governs expression, analysis, research and words. In its decade the theme leans to earning a place through speaking, writing, research and reasoning, suiting teaching, communication, law, consulting, research and content. The strength is strong logic, depth and penetrating expression; the risk is disputes and saying too much, so the key is grounding expression in expertise and setting tact for speech.
cnDesc: 巨门主表达、辨析、研究与口舌，大限走巨门的十年，人生主题偏「靠说话、写作、研究和思辨立身」，适合教学、传播、法律、咨询、研究与内容行业。好处是逻辑强、能深挖、表达有穿透力，风险是非口舌、言多必失，关键是把表达接到专业上、给说话立分寸。

cnTitle: 流年走紫微：这一年想站到主位上，怎么把机会接住又不硬撑
enTitle: A Zi Wei Year: Stepping Into the Lead, Taking the Chance Without Overextending
enDesc: When Zi Wei hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to leadership, responsibility and visibility, often bringing chances to initiate, answer for and stand out. Yet the annual cycle sits beneath the natal chart and the decade, so a single year sets rhythm rather than long-term conclusions; the key is whether support and a team exist, and not pushing on pride alone.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由紫微主事，这一年的基调偏「主位、责任、被看见」，容易遇到牵头、负责、出头的机会。但流年在本命和大限之下，单一年份只主节奏不主长期结论，关键是看这一年有没有辅佐和班底，别只凭面子硬撑。

cnTitle: 流年走贪狼：这一年机会和欲望一起变多，怎么收放才不白忙
enTitle: A Tan Lang Year: When Opportunities and Appetites Both Multiply, How to Choose
enDesc: When Tan Lang hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to liveliness, change and many entry points for opportunity, with networks, interests, romance and new tries all more active than usual. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is gathering broad chances into one or two main lines rather than overreaching and draining resources in the buzz.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由贪狼主事，这一年的基调偏「活跃、多变、欲望和机会入口多」，人脉、兴趣、桃花和新尝试都会比平时旺。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是把广泛的机会收成一两条主线，别贪多嚼不烂、在热闹里把资源耗掉。

cnTitle: 流年走太阳：这一年想发光、想帮人，怎么照亮别人也不亏自己
enTitle: A Tai Yang Year: Wanting to Shine and Help Without Burning Yourself Out
enDesc: When Tai Yang hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to warmth, visibility, responsibility and being needed, often bringing a more public role and the trust of others. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is directing and bounding that giving, so you do not light up everyone while shortchanging yourself and family.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由太阳主事，这一年基调偏「热情、曝光、承担与被需要」，容易站到台前、承担公共角色、被人托付。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是给付出设方向和边界，别照了所有人唯独亏了自己和家人。

cnTitle: 流年走天机：这一年脑子转得快、变动也多，怎么把想法落地
enTitle: A Tian Ji Year: A Quick Mind and Many Changes, and How to Land the Ideas
enDesc: When Tian Ji hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to thought, planning, learning and adaptiveness, with ideas, chances and changes denser than usual, suiting study, planning, transitions and intellectual work. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is gathering thought into executable steps, rather than thinking for a year without taking the first step.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由天机主事，这一年基调偏「思维、策划、学习与机变」，想法、机会和变动都比平时密，适合学习、规划、转型和动脑的事。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是把思考收成可执行的步骤，别想了一年却没开第一步。

cnTitle: 流年走武曲：这一年务实讲执行，怎么把事做成、把钱攒稳
enTitle: A Wu Qu Year: Pragmatism and Execution, Getting Things Done and Building Steady Savings
enDesc: When Wu Qu hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to real work, responsibility and financial accumulation, suiting those who build a place through expertise and follow-through, and often bringing matters tied to money, contracts and execution. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is directing that hardness to long-term goals, and not straining those near by being too rule-bound.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由武曲主事，这一年基调偏「实干、责任、财务积累」，适合靠专业和执行力立身，也容易遇到与钱、合同、执行相关的事。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是把硬劲用在长期目标上，也别因为太讲规则把身边人绷太紧。

cnTitle: 流年走七杀：这一年要攻坚、要独立，怎么把硬骨头啃下来
enTitle: A Qi Sha Year: Taking On Hard Problems Independently and Seeing Them Through
enDesc: When Qi Sha hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to tough battles, pioneering and relying on oneself, often bringing situations that demand resolve and accountability, and also favoring changing tracks and opening new ground. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is choosing the right battles and keeping a fallback, rather than charging on impulse and harming health and relationships together.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由七杀主事，这一年基调偏「硬仗、开拓、靠自己」，容易遇到需要决断和承担的局面，也利换赛道、开新局。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是选对战场、留好后路，别凭血气硬冲把健康和关系一起伤了。

cnTitle: 流年走破军：这一年要破旧立新，怎么把变动变成机会
enTitle: A Po Jun Year: Breaking the Old to Build the New, Turning Change Into Opportunity
enDesc: When Po Jun hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to change, breaking the old, restructuring and starting anew, often bringing job changes, moving, structural adjustment and ending old ties, and also favors thorough transformation. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is building after breaking, rather than only tearing down and draining resources in the change.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由破军主事，这一年基调偏「变动、破旧、重组与开新」，容易遇到换工作、搬家、调整结构、结束旧关系等事，也利彻底转型。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是破了之后要立，别只拆不建、在变动里把资源耗光。

cnTitle: 流年走天府：这一年重库藏与稳定，怎么把日子过厚、把资源守住
enTitle: A Tian Fu Year: Focusing on Storage and Stability, Building a Thicker Life and Holding Resources
enDesc: When Tian Fu hosts the annual Life Palace, the year leans to stewardship, storage, stability and accumulation, suiting managing assets, consolidating existing ground and building long-term reserves, and also favors home purchase, savings and organizational building. Yet the annual cycle sets only one year’s rhythm; the key is leaving room for growth alongside stewardship, rather than letting steadiness become conservatism and stagnation.
cnDesc: 流年命宫由天府主事，这一年基调偏「守成、库藏、稳定与积累」，适合打理资产、巩固已有局面、做长期储备，也利买房、储蓄、组织建设。但流年只主一年节奏，关键是在守成之外留出成长，别把稳变成保守和停滞。

cnTitle: 流年丧门怎么看：主悲伤与家宅情绪低落，是提醒不是定灾
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Sang Men Star: Sorrow and Low Household Mood as a Reminder, Not a Fixed Disaster
enDesc: Sang Men is one of the annual auxiliary stars, traditionally governing mourning, sorrow and low household mood, as well as condolence visits, checking on people and a quiet atmosphere. Yet in Zi Wei Dou Shu these stars only act as a temporary plus-minus layer; the major stars, four transformations and the decade carry the real reading, and one cannot conclude disaster from Sang Men alone. Seeing it should instead prompt attention to elders’ health, household mood and one’s own mindset, with checkups and companionship arranged early.
cnDesc: 丧门是流年神煞之一，传统主孝服、悲伤、家宅情绪低落，也对应吊唁、探视、冷清的氛围。但神煞在紫微里只做加减分的临时层，主星、四化和大限才主断，不能单凭一颗丧门就断灾。看到它更该做的是关注长辈健康、家宅情绪和自己的心态，提前安排体检和陪伴。

cnTitle: 流年白虎怎么看：主突发冲击与急性事件，防冲动更要重安全
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Bai Hu Star: Sudden Shocks and Acute Events, Guarding Impulse and Prioritizing Safety
enDesc: Bai Hu is one of the annual auxiliary stars, traditionally governing sudden shocks, accidents, acute events and bloodshed, as well as short temper, conflict, surgery and traffic. Yet auxiliary stars only act as a temporary plus-minus layer; the major stars and four transformations carry the real reading, and one cannot conclude misfortune from Bai Hu alone. Seeing it should instead prompt slowing the pace that year, paying attention to safety and checkups, and avoiding impulsive decisions and fierce conflict.
cnDesc: 白虎是流年神煞之一，传统主突发冲击、意外、急性事件和血光，也对应脾气急、冲突、手术和交通。但神煞只做临时加减层，主星四化才主断，不能单凭白虎就断凶。看到它更该做的是这一年放慢节奏、注意安全与体检、避免冲动决策和激烈冲突。

cnTitle: 流年吊客怎么看：主悲观阻碍与虚惊，少远行争讼多静心
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Diao Ke Star: Pessimism, Obstacles and False Scares, Traveling and Litigating Less, Staying Calm More
enDesc: Diao Ke is one of the annual auxiliary stars, traditionally governing pessimism, obstacles and false scares related to mourning, as well as low mood, things not going smoothly and being tripped up by small matters. Yet auxiliary stars only act as a temporary plus-minus layer; the major stars and four transformations carry the real reading, and one cannot conclude misfortune from Diao Ke alone. Seeing it should instead prompt adjusting mindset that year, reducing travel and litigation, slowing the pace, and not frightening oneself over false scares.
cnDesc: 吊客是流年神煞之一，传统主悲观、阻碍、吊丧虚惊，也对应情绪低落、做事不顺、被小事绊住。但神煞只做临时加减层，主星四化才主断，不能单凭吊客就断凶。看到它更该做的是这一年调整心态、减少远行和争讼、把节奏放慢，遇到虚惊不自己吓自己。

cnTitle: 流年病符怎么看：主小病伤与亚健康，防过劳更要重正规体检
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Bing Fu Star: Minor Ailments and Suboptimal Health, Guarding Overwork and Prioritizing Proper Checkups
enDesc: Bing Fu is one of the annual auxiliary stars, traditionally governing minor illness, injury, suboptimal health and fatigue, as well as small signals from the body and recurring chronic issues. Yet auxiliary stars only act as a temporary plus-minus layer; the major stars and four transformations carry the real reading, and one cannot conclude serious illness from Bing Fu alone. Seeing it should instead prompt regular routines that year, guarding against overwork, keeping checkups on schedule, and seeking proper medical care promptly for discomfort, neither pushing through nor frightening oneself.
cnDesc: 病符是流年神煞之一，传统主小病、伤灾、亚健康和疲劳，也对应身体发出的小信号、慢性问题反复。但神煞只做临时加减层，主星四化才主断，不能单凭病符就断重病。看到它更该做的是这一年规律作息、防过劳、按时体检，有不适及时正规就医，不硬扛也不自行吓自己。

cnTitle: 流年天狗怎么看：主损耗破相与小意外，防磕碰更要看护孩童宠物
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Tian Gou Star: Loss, Disfigurement and Small Accidents, Guarding Bumps and Watching Over Children and Pets
enDesc: Tian Gou is one of the annual auxiliary stars, traditionally governing loss, disfigurement, small accidents and bumps, as well as small situations related to pets and children, and things easily getting damaged. Yet auxiliary stars only act as a temporary plus-minus layer; the major stars and four transformations carry the real reading, and one cannot conclude misfortune from Tian Gou alone. Seeing it should instead prompt paying attention to safety that year, watching over children and pets, taking care of belongings, and not taking small losses to heart.
cnDesc: 天狗是流年神煞之一，传统主损耗、破相、小意外和磕碰，也对应宠物、孩童相关的小状况、东西容易损坏。但神煞只做临时加减层，主星四化才主断，不能单凭天狗就断凶。看到它更该做的是这一年注意安全、看护好孩童和宠物、保管好财物，小损耗不放在心上。

cnTitle: 流年贯索怎么看：主束缚文书纠纷与拖延，重书面合同和专业法律意见
enTitle: How to Read the Annual Guan Suo Star: Restraint, Document Disputes and Delay, Emphasizing Written Contracts and Professional Legal Advice
enDesc: Guan Suo is one of the annual auxiliary stars, traditionally governing restraint, small disputes over documents and contracts, delay and entanglement, as well as cumbersome procedures, being tied down by affairs and problems in contract details. Yet auxiliary stars only act as a temporary plus-minus layer; the major stars and four transformations carry the real reading, and one cannot conclude legal trouble from Guan Suo alone. Seeing it should instead prompt putting contracts in writing that year, checking details carefully, and in disputes relying on professional legal advice and proper channels, neither settling privately nor delaying.
cnDesc: 贯索是流年神煞之一，传统主束缚、文书合约小纠纷、拖延和纠缠，也对应手续繁琐、被事务绊住、合同细节出问题。但神煞只做临时加减层，主星四化才主断，不能单凭贯索就断官非。看到它更该做的是这一年合同走书面、细节核对清楚、遇到纠纷以专业法律意见和正规途径为准，不私了也不拖延。

cnTitle: 武曲天府同在官禄宫：事业既讲执行又重库藏，怎么把局面做厚做稳
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Fu in the Career Palace: Execution and Storage in One Career, Building It Thick and Steady
enDesc: The Career Palace reads how one works and the shape of a career. Wu Qu governs pragmatic execution while Tian Fu governs solid storage, so together one can both get things done and hold resources and reserves, suiting management, finance and tax, operations and large platforms. The risk is conservatism, weak drive and holding money too tightly, so the key is making room for expansion and delegation alongside stewardship.
cnDesc: 官禄宫看做事方式与事业格局，武曲主务实执行、天府主厚实守藏，两星同落在这里，事业上既能把事做成、又能把资源和家底守住，适合管理、财税、运营和大型平台。风险在偏保守、缺冲劲、把钱看得太紧，关键是在守成之外留出拓展和授权。

cnTitle: 武曲天府同在迁移宫：外出既务实又稳重，怎么把异地发展做厚
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Fu in the Travel Palace: Pragmatic and Steady Away From Home, Building Thick Development Elsewhere
enDesc: The Travel Palace reads the external environment, development elsewhere and the state away from home. Wu Qu governs pragmatic execution while Tian Fu governs solid storage, so together, when away or developing elsewhere, one can both work steadily and hold resources, suiting working out of town, postings, long-term travel and buying property elsewhere. The risk is conservatism and seeking stability away from home to the point of missing chances, so the key is leaving room for active pioneering alongside steadiness.
cnDesc: 迁移宫看外部环境、异地发展和出门在外的状态，武曲主务实执行、天府主厚实守藏，两星同落在这里，外出或异地发展时既能踏实做事、又能把资源守住，适合去外地打拼、派驻、长期差旅和异地置业。风险在偏保守、出门求稳反而错过机会，关键是在稳重之外留出主动开拓。

cnTitle: 武曲贪狼同在夫妻宫：伴侣既务实又活络，怎么把现实和浪漫处平衡
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tan Lang in the Spouse Palace: A Practical Yet Lively Partner, Balancing Reality and Romance
enDesc: The Spouse Palace reads the long-term relationship pattern. Wu Qu governs pragmatism and reality while Tan Lang governs liveliness, desire and romance, so partners tend to be capable, realistic and also enjoyment- and social-oriented, with both daily necessities and fresh excitement in the relationship. The risk is practical calculation and changing desire coexisting, easily causing friction over money or novelty, so the key is embracing both pragmatism and romance and setting boundaries for the relationship.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫看长期关系的互动模式，武曲主务实讲现实、贪狼主活络多欲重情趣，两星同落在这里，伴侣多是能干、现实、也懂享受和交际的类型，关系里既有柴米油盐也有新鲜热闹。风险是现实计较与欲望多变并存，容易因钱或新鲜感生隙，关键是把务实和情趣都接住、给关系立边界。

cnTitle: 武曲贪狼同在福德宫：精神既务实又爱享受，怎么把欲望过成不内耗
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tan Lang in the Karma Palace: A Practical Yet Enjoyment-Loving Spirit, Living Desire Without Inner Drain
enDesc: The Karma Palace reads the inner world, ways of enjoyment and inner satisfaction. Wu Qu governs pragmatism and reality while Tan Lang governs strong desire and enjoyment, so inwardly one values both practical gains and romance and novelty, suiting satisfaction through material things and experiences. The risk is many desires and practical calculation, easily causing anxiety from wanting too much, so the key is ordering desires, setting a budget for enjoyment, and not letting the spirit be dragged by material desire.
cnDesc: 福德宫看精神世界、享受方式和内心满足，武曲主务实讲现实、贪狼主多欲重享受，两星同落在这里，内心既看重实际收益、也追求情趣和新鲜，适合靠物质和体验获得满足。风险是欲望多、计较现实，容易想要的太多而焦虑，关键是把欲望排序、给享受立预算，不让精神被物欲拖着走。

cnTitle: 武曲天相同在夫妻宫：伴侣既务实又正派，怎么把硬劲处成温柔
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Xiang in the Spouse Palace: A Practical, Upright Partner and Turning Firmness Into Tenderness
enDesc: The Spouse Palace reads the long-term relationship pattern. Wu Qu governs pragmatism and reality while Tian Xiang governs integrity and tact, so partners tend to be capable, proper and responsible, with the relationship valuing both practicality and dignity. The risk is being too firm and rule-bound, lacking softness and romance, so the key is using principles for boundaries and keeping tenderness for daily life.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫看长期关系的互动模式，武曲主务实讲现实、天相主正派懂分寸，两星同落在这里，伴侣多是能干、规矩、有责任感的类型，关系里讲实际也讲体面。风险是太硬、太讲规则，少了柔软和情趣，关键是把原则用在边界上、把温柔留给日常。

cnTitle: 武曲天相同在田宅宫：家庭既务实又讲秩序，怎么把家经营稳
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Xiang in the Property Palace: A Practical, Orderly Home and How to Run It Steadily
enDesc: The Property Palace reads home, real estate and accumulated assets. Wu Qu governs pragmatic execution while Tian Xiang governs integrity and tact, so together the family values order and rules and assets are relatively steady, suiting managing property, household expenses and family systems. The risk is being too rule-bound, with a hard home and little ease, so the key is letting the home hold both order and warmth.
cnDesc: 田宅宫看家庭、房产与资产沉淀，武曲主务实讲执行、天相主正派懂分寸，两星同落在这里，家庭观念重、讲究秩序和规矩、家产相对稳，适合打理房产、家用和家庭制度。风险是太讲规矩、家里偏硬、少松弛，关键是让家既有秩序也有温度。

cnTitle: 武曲七杀同在迁移宫：外出敢打硬仗，怎么把冲劲用成异地发展
enTitle: Wu Qu and Qi Sha in the Travel Palace: Daring Hard Battles Away From Home, Turning Drive Into Development Elsewhere
enDesc: The Travel Palace reads the external environment, development elsewhere and the state away from home. Wu Qu governs pragmatic execution while Qi Sha governs courageous tackling of hard problems, so together, when away or developing elsewhere, one has strong drive, resolve and the ability to carry difficult work, suiting pioneering elsewhere, postings and high-challenge tasks. The risk is head-on clashes, risk and solitude, so the key is courage with a plan, the right direction and a fallback.
cnDesc: 迁移宫看外部环境、异地发展和出门在外的状态，武曲主务实执行、七杀主果敢攻坚，两星同落在这里，外出或异地发展时冲劲足、敢决断、能啃硬骨头，适合去外地开拓、派驻、做高挑战的事。风险是硬碰、冒险、孤克，关键是勇而有谋、选对方向并留后路。

cnTitle: 武曲破军同在福德宫：精神既务实又爱变动，怎么把折腾过成不耗散
enTitle: Wu Qu and Po Jun in the Karma Palace: A Practical Yet Change-Loving Spirit, Living Upheaval Without Dissipation
enDesc: The Karma Palace reads the inner world, ways of enjoyment and inner satisfaction. Wu Qu governs pragmatism and reality while Po Jun governs breaking the old and change, so inwardly one values practical gains yet is restless with the status quo, always wanting to change, break through and try new things. The risk is too much change, only breaking without building, and spiritual dissipation, so the key is knowing what to build before acting, and keeping a budget and transition period for change.
cnDesc: 福德宫看精神世界、享受方式和内心满足，武曲主务实讲现实、破军主破旧变动，两星同落在这里，内心既看重实际收益、又不安于现状，总想换、想突破、想尝试新的。风险是变动过多、只破不立、精神耗散，关键是想清楚要建什么再动，给变动留预算和过渡期。

cnTitle: 太阳太阴同在官禄宫：事业既外放又内敛，怎么把明暗两条路都走通
enTitle: Tai Yang and Tai Yin in the Career Palace: Both Outward and Inward in Career, Making Both the Visible and Hidden Paths Work
enDesc: The Career Palace reads how one works and the shape of a career. Tai Yang governs outward warmth while Tai Yin governs inward refinement, so together, the sun and moon in the same palace, one can both stand in front and work deeply behind the scenes, suiting work that balances visibility and expertise, external and internal. The risk is tension between outward and inward and scattered energy, so the key is distinguishing when to push and when to hold, using the two energies in different stages.
cnDesc: 官禄宫看做事方式与事业格局，太阳主外放热情、太阴主内敛细腻，两星同落在这里（即「日月同宫」），事业上既能站到台前、也能做幕后深耕，适合需要兼顾曝光和专业、对外和对内的工作。风险是明暗拉扯、精力分散，关键是分清什么时候该冲、什么时候该守，把两种能量用在不同阶段。

cnTitle: 太阳太阴同在田宅宫：家庭既重体面又重细腻，怎么把家经营得明暗相宜
enTitle: Tai Yang and Tai Yin in the Property Palace: A Home Valuing Both Dignity and Refinement, Running It With Visible and Hidden Care
enDesc: The Property Palace reads home, real estate and accumulated assets. Tai Yang governs dignity and warmth while Tai Yin governs refinement and nurturing, so together, sun and moon in one palace, the family values both appearance and public image and internal detail and emotional care, with a home that is often lively yet tidy, with both light and warmth. The risk is tension between outward and inward and uneven allocation of energy between external and internal, so the key is letting the home hold both dignity and ease.
cnDesc: 田宅宫看家庭、房产与资产沉淀，太阳主体面热情、太阴主细腻滋养，两星同落在这里（日月同宫），家庭既讲究门面和公共形象、也重内部细节和情感滋养，家里往往热闹也整洁、有光也有暖。风险是明暗拉扯、对外和对内精力分配不均，关键是让家既有体面也有松弛。

cnTitle: 太阳巨门同在财帛宫：靠曝光和表达赚钱，怎么把口舌变成财源
enTitle: Tai Yang and Ju Men in the Wealth Palace: Earning Through Visibility and Expression, Turning Words Into Income
enDesc: The Wealth Palace reads how one earns and the financial state. Tai Yang governs visibility and warmth while Ju Men governs expression and analysis, so together one suits earning through the front stage, communication, teaching, consulting, law and other fields built on speaking and being seen. The strength is income tied to expression and reputation; the risk is verbal disputes, saying too much and money coming and going, so the key is grounding expression in expertise and building a stable structure for income.
cnDesc: 财帛宫看赚钱方式和财务状态，太阳主曝光热情、巨门主表达辨析，两星同落在这里，适合靠台前、传播、教学、咨询、法律等靠说话和被看见赚钱的行业。好处是财源和表达、名气挂钩，风险是口舌是非、言多必失、财来财去，关键是把表达接到专业上、给收入立稳定结构。

cnTitle: 太阳天梁同在福德宫：精神既热情又成熟，怎么把付出过成不委屈
enTitle: Tai Yang and Tian Liang in the Karma Palace: A Warm Yet Mature Spirit, Living Giving Without Resentment
enDesc: The Karma Palace reads the inner world, ways of enjoyment and inner satisfaction. Tai Yang governs warm dedication while Tian Liang governs principles and shelter, so inwardly one both wants to shine and help others and values principles and reason, suiting satisfaction through service, guidance, public welfare and professional helping. The risk is giving too much, being preachy and feeling resentful, so the key is setting boundaries for giving, using principles in expertise, and not letting warm-heartedness become lecturing and inner drain.
cnDesc: 福德宫看精神世界、享受方式和内心满足，太阳主热情奉献、天梁主原则荫庇，两星同落在这里，内心既想发光帮人、又重原则和道理，适合在服务、指导、公益和专业助人中获得满足。风险是付出过多、好为人师、觉得委屈，关键是给付出设边界、把原则用在专业上，别让热心变成说教和内耗。

cnTitle: 太阳天梁同在夫妻宫：伴侣既热情又成熟，怎么把关心不变成说教
enTitle: Tai Yang and Tian Liang in the Spouse Palace: A Warm, Mature Partner and Keeping Care From Turning Into Lectures
enDesc: The Spouse Palace reads the long-term relationship pattern. Tai Yang governs warm dedication while Tian Liang governs principles and shelter, so partners tend to be warm-hearted, mature, caring and reasonable, with plenty of giving and advice in the relationship. The risk is giving too much, being preachy and feeling resentful, so the key is turning care into companionship and respect and setting boundaries for giving.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫看长期关系的互动模式，太阳主热情奉献、天梁主原则荫庇，两星同落在这里，伴侣多是热心、成熟、肯照顾人、也讲道理的类型，关系里付出和忠告都不少。风险是付出过多、好为人师、觉得委屈，关键是把关心收成陪伴和尊重、给付出设边界。

cnTitle: 天同天梁同在命宫：温和又成熟，怎么把福气用成不松散的人生
enTitle: Tian Tong and Tian Liang in the Life Palace: Gentle and Mature, Turning Fortune Into a Life That Is Not Slack
enDesc: The Life Palace reads the underlying character and basic direction of life. Tian Tong governs gentleness and enjoyment while Tian Liang governs principles and shelter, so together, the Tong Liang pattern, one is gentle, mature, fortunate and reasonable, suiting education, service, consulting and professional helping fields. The risk is slackness, being preachy and weak drive, so the key is setting goals and discipline within ease and turning fortune into accumulation.
cnDesc: 命宫看性格底色与人生基本方向，天同主温和享受、天梁主原则荫庇，两星同落在这里（即「同梁」格局），为人温和、成熟、有福气、也讲道理，适合文教、服务、咨询、专业助人等领域。风险是松散、好为人师、缺冲劲，关键是在舒服里给自己立目标和纪律，把福气用成积累。

cnTitle: 天同天梁同在迁移宫：外出温和又成熟，怎么把人缘用成异地发展
enTitle: Tian Tong and Tian Liang in the Travel Palace: Gentle and Mature Away From Home, Turning Rapport Into Development Elsewhere
enDesc: The Travel Palace reads the external environment, development elsewhere and the state away from home. Tian Tong governs gentle service while Tian Liang governs principles and shelter, so together, when away or developing elsewhere, one has good rapport, maturity and steadiness, and is easily accepted and cared for, suiting service, education, consulting and professional work out of town. The risk is slackness, being preachy and weak drive, so the key is actively setting goals within the good rapport elsewhere, not treating comfort as a stopping point.
cnDesc: 迁移宫看外部环境、异地发展和出门在外的状态，天同主温和服务、天梁主原则荫庇，两星同落在这里，外出或异地发展时人缘好、成熟稳重、容易被接纳和照顾，适合去外地做服务、文教、咨询、专业类工作。风险是偏松散、好说教、缺冲劲，关键是在异地的好人缘里主动立目标，不把舒服当停留。

cnTitle: 天同巨门同在命宫：温和又善辩，怎么把服务和表达用成不内耗
enTitle: Tian Tong and Ju Men in the Life Palace: Gentle and Articulate, Turning Service and Expression Into a Life Without Inner Drain
enDesc: The Life Palace reads the underlying character and basic direction of life. Tian Tong governs gentle service while Ju Men governs expression and analysis, so together, the Tong Ju pattern, one is approachable, communicative, logical and willing to help, suiting teaching, communication, consulting, customer service and research built on dialogue. The risk is verbal disputes, emotional ups and downs and overthinking, so the key is grounding expression in expertise and setting tact for speaking.
cnDesc: 命宫看性格底色与人生基本方向，天同主温和服务、巨门主表达辨析，两星同落在这里（即「同巨」格局），为人亲和、善沟通、逻辑好、也愿意帮人，适合教学、传播、咨询、客服、研究等靠沟通立身的领域。风险是口舌是非、情绪起伏、想得多，关键是把表达接到专业上、给开口立分寸。

cnTitle: 天机天梁同在命宫：善思又成熟，怎么把谋略用成不孤高的人生
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tian Liang in the Life Palace: Thoughtful and Mature, Turning Strategy Into a Life That Is Not Proudly Isolated
enDesc: The Life Palace reads the underlying character and basic direction of life. Tian Ji governs thought and planning while Tian Liang governs principles and shelter, so together, the Ji Liang pattern, one is bright, mature, strategic and reasonable, suiting research, planning, consulting, education and professional oversight built on mind and experience. The risk is overthinking, proud isolation, lecturing and weak action, so the key is gathering thought into executable steps and using maturity in service.
cnDesc: 命宫看性格底色与人生基本方向，天机主思维策划、天梁主原则荫庇，两星同落在这里（即「机梁」格局），为人聪明、成熟、善谋划、也讲道理，适合研究、策划、咨询、教育、专业督导等靠脑子和经验立身的领域。风险是想太多、孤高说教、缺行动力，关键是把思考收成可执行的步骤、把成熟用在服务上。

cnTitle: 天机天梁同在田宅宫：家庭善思又重原则，怎么把家经营得有条理有温度
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tian Liang in the Property Palace: A Thoughtful, Principled Home, Running It With Order and Warmth
enDesc: The Property Palace reads home, real estate and accumulated assets. Tian Ji governs thought and planning while Tian Liang governs principles and shelter, so together the family values order, rules and is good at planning household expenses and property, suiting managing family assets, planning living arrangements and family systems. The risk is overthinking, being preachy and a home that is too rational with little warmth, so the key is using order for affairs and keeping warmth for family members.
cnDesc: 田宅宫看家庭、房产与资产沉淀，天机主思维策划、天梁主原则荫庇，两星同落在这里，家庭里重条理、讲规矩、也善谋划家用和房产，适合打理家庭资产、规划居住和家庭制度。风险是想太多、好说教、家里偏理性少温度，关键是把条理用在事务上、把温度留给家人。

cnTitle: 廉贞贪狼同在命宫：有原则又多欲，怎么把魅力和交际用成不纠葛的人生
enTitle: Lian Zhen and Tan Lang in the Life Palace: Principled Yet Desirous, Turning Charm and Sociability Into a Life Without Tangles
enDesc: The Life Palace reads the underlying character and basic direction of life. Lian Zhen governs principles and sociability while Tan Lang governs desire and versatility, so together, the Lian Tan pattern, one is charming, sociable, principled and multi-talented, suiting public relations, culture, entertainment, sales and management fields requiring charm and tact. The risk is romantic entanglement, excessive desire and legal or verbal disputes, so the key is holding boundaries and gathering desire into a few main lines.
cnDesc: 命宫看性格底色与人生基本方向，廉贞主原则交际、贪狼主欲望多才，两星同落在这里（即「廉贪」格局），为人有魅力、善交际、有原则、也多才多艺，适合公关、文化、娱乐、销售、管理等需要魅力和分寸的领域。风险是感情纠葛、欲望过多、官非口舌，关键是守住边界、把欲望收成几条主线。

cnTitle: 廉贞天府同在福德宫：精神既讲原则又重库藏，怎么把分寸过成不紧绷
enTitle: Lian Zhen and Tian Fu in the Karma Palace: A Spirit That Values Both Principles and Storage, Living Tact Without Tension
enDesc: The Karma Palace reads the inner world, ways of enjoyment and inner satisfaction. Lian Zhen governs principles and tact while Tian Fu governs solid storage, so inwardly one values both rules and boundaries and accumulation and steadiness, suiting satisfaction through order, expertise and assets. The risk is being too principled, holding too tightly and mental tension, so the key is leaving room for ease and enjoyment beyond rules, not letting the spirit become a tightly shut storehouse.
cnDesc: 福德宫看精神世界、享受方式和内心满足，廉贞主原则分寸、天府主厚实守藏，两星同落在这里，内心既重规矩和边界、也看重积累和安稳，适合在秩序、专业和资产中获得满足。风险是太讲原则、守得太紧、精神紧绷，关键是在守规矩之外留出松弛和享受，别把精神变成一座紧关的库。
